businessGoal: Allow visitors to reach out for support or inquiries.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is accessible when navigating to the contact page.
Ensure that all required fields (first name, last name, email, subject, message) are displayed in the contact form.
Verify that the subject dropdown includes all specified options.
Check that a validation error is shown when a message with fewer than 50 characters is entered.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed and the form is hidden upon successful submission with valid data.
